jobs.name: 雨竹听风
jobs.details: Keep the jade bamboo contour, mist-white opaque interior, orange-haired tiger girl in the pale jade outfit, bamboo hairpin and closed umbrella; delicate sparse watercolor foliage only at corners.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction.
Input image 1 is the approved skin concept board. Convert its illustrated popup into a production PNG skin background. Preserve the exact character identity, costume, line style, theme palette, mood and decorative vocabulary.
Output exactly ONE isolated, complete candidate popup background asset on genuine transparent alpha; not a board, not a collage, not a screenshot. Remove every Chinese/Latin word, number, title, ab composition text, cursor, separator between candidates, swatches, selection highlight box and all presentation scenery. The entire interior must be completely blank, opaque and calm, ready for live text to be drawn by software. Remove the selected first-candidate pill as well.
Crisp high quality anime illustration. Outside the character and bordered popup, use alpha=0; no paper/white canvas, no checkerboard drawn into the bitmap, no colored halo, no detached drop shadows, no visual annotations. Keep clean silhouettes fully within canvas, with roughly 12 pixels clear padding at outermost edges. Reconstruct only details required to convert to this usable asset; don't invent a new character. No text anywhere.
Skin: 02 雨竹听风. Keep the jade bamboo contour, mist-white opaque interior, orange-haired tiger girl in the pale jade outfit, bamboo hairpin and closed umbrella; delicate sparse watercolor foliage only at corners.
Extract and adapt the UPPER HORIZONTAL skin from the reference. Landscape output 1536 x 1024 pixels. One wide rounded text bar extends nearly full canvas width across the bottom, approximately x=30..1506, y=650..995. Keep its entire interior blank and opaque. The character and its accessories sit above the top-right end (approximately x=880..1490, y=30..660), leaning on the top border. The middle strip x=450..650 must have NO character, foliage or independent ornament anywhere above/below the bar: just transparent area above and straight border/flat interior below, so this strip can extend horizontally without stretching the character. Concentrate border decoration at left/right corners. A horizontal cut near y=820 must pass through plain straight side rims and the empty interior, without touching ornament or character. Do not make a tall empty poster or additional frames.
